method: Original insert/grow/fixup/rotations run in Unicorn without interception; only the allocator vtable (alloc/realloc/free) is an authored deterministic stub shared in model by the Python side
comparisons: allocator call sequence (kind, size, alignment, tag, pointers)
all bytes of 0x9f000-byte fixture (descriptor, initial and grown node arrays, junk-filled uninitialized slots) after every call
red-black validity after every call: BST order unsigned 64-bit, parent links, root black, no red-red, equal black height, live count, free-list partition of used slots
coverage: null pointer and capacity 0..6 initial arrays growing to 2x/4
free-list slot reuse (removals via pose_body_tree _Tree.remove key_size 8 between inserts)
ascending, descending, random, boundary-value (high bit) and small-domain keys
limits: Fixtures are synthetic; removals are authored Python (pose_body_tree) mirrored into native memory.
Allocator is an authored stub: real allocator alignment/tag behavior and failure are not modeled.
No live gameplay identity or concurrency proof.
